subject: Proof paths for 'no-learning' exports and subprocessor attestations — next steps
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@medicacloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: DPA redline + evidence request for no-learning path

David / Kim —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached is our redline to the DPA (MedicaCloud_DPA_redline_v3.pdf) — the legal team has three blockers we need to resolve before we can sign:

1) A firm commitment that customer interactions from our tenant will not be used to improve models (no-learning / no-training).
2) A defined export lane demonstrating how tenant data can leave Redwood (SFTP vs API) and proof that exports are retained only onshore.
3) A subprocessor inventory and attestation that any subprocessors touching MedicaCloud data are listed and contractually bound to the same no-training restriction.

Questions: can you provide an evidence pack for the no-learning commitment (ops runbook, sample export log, hashed sample transcript)? Also, do you have a standard attestation template that covers subprocessors?

We need SOC 2 and the subprocessor CSV as part of our procurement intake. Can you confirm a realistic timeline for those items?

Attachments: MedicaCloud_DPA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf)

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Legal Ops, MedicaCloud
emma.liu@medicacloud.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@medicacloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA redline + evidence request for no-learning path

Emma —

Appreciate the clear list. We can commit operationally to a no-learning mode for your tenant and provide the following artifacts:

- Operational attestation signed by Redwood Security (no-learning configuration locked for tenant).
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV) with contract status and effective dates.
- Export lane options:
  * SFTP batch export (onshore destination) — Ops-configurable, preferred for full custody exports.
  * API ephemeral lane with KV-ephemeral retention (short TTL) — lower latency, but requires acceptance of transient telemetry for debugging (we can redact/obfuscate).
- Sample evidence: hashed transcript sample, export log snippet, and an ops runbook excerpt indicating retention and deletion rules.

Next steps (proposed):
1) We produce the subprocessor_inventory.csv and the no_train_evidence_checklist.xlsx by EOD Friday (2028-05-25).
2) Security will produce a short attestation PDF confirming configuration controls and KMS residency constraints.
3) We’ll present a short ops runbook and a sample hashed transcript (one-off) to your security team via Drive link.

I've attached a checklist that outlines exactly what we'll produce. If SFTP is your preference for exports, confirm the onshore hostname and we'll provision an export user/ACL.

Attachments: no_train_evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Manager, Product Security — Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: MedicaCloud evidence pack & subprocessor gating

Kim / Marissa — quick internal plan before we send to MedicaCloud.

Summary of required artifacts:
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV) — include CloudStorageCo (object storage), KMSPartner (managed KMS), LoggingOps (log routing), and OnPremOps (SFTP operations).
- Security attestation (no-learning) — signed by Security lead + pointer to config toggle in tenant metadata.
- Sample evidence:
  * hashed_transcript_sample.txt (sha256 of a redacted conversation)
  * export_log_snippet.log (timestamped export job showing onshore destination)
  * ops_runbook_excerpt.pdf (steps for SFTP provisioning + retention policy)

Operational notes:
- SFTP lane requires OnPremOps to provision a dedicated user with chroot and retention rules. Timeline to spin up: 3 business days after we get destination host/IP and PO.
- KMS residency: Onshore KMS is doable but requires KMSPartner to update key policy (2–4 business days).
- Legal: we should propose this short DPA language to close the loop: "Redwood will not use Customer Content for Model Improvement and will not persist Customer Content beyond agreed retention windows except as required by law." (Kim, can you confirm legal sign-off on that phrasing?)

Action items:
- Marissa: draft subprocessor_inventory.csv and attach current SOC2 snapshot.
- Kim: propose final DPA sentence and confirm if Security attestation PDF template is available.
- David: coordinate with OnPremOps for SFTP provisioning and collect an export sample.

Thanks — keep this tight, procurement wants an answer this week.

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@medicacloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedicaCloud Legal <legal@medicacloud.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 17:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA redline + evidence request for no-learning path

David —

Thanks, that approach sounds reasonable. We prefer the SFTP batch export lane for initial go-live (onshore export host will be sftp.medicacloud-us.example). Please proceed with provisioning once you have the host details and PO.

Two asks to close:
- Confirm the exact DPA no-learning sentence you will include so our counsel can sign off quickly.
- Send DocuSign link for the final DPA once you incorporate the agreed sentence and confirm the attestation will be attached.

Attachments: MedicaCloud_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx) — will fill and return with SOC 2 request.

If you can deliver the subprocessor CSV and attestation by EOD Friday, we can fast-track signature next week.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Legal Ops, MedicaCloud

On Thu, May 23, 2028 at 16:30, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Emma — sending proposed language below for quick review: 
> 
> "Redwood Inference will not use Customer Content (including prompts and responses) for training or model improvement, and will restrict retention of Customer Content to the retention window specified in Appendix A, except as required by law."
> 
> If that looks good to you we'll fold it into the DPA and attach the attestation.
> 
> —David
